ABOUT US

A shared love.
A sweeter story.

Saffron & Crumbs began with a mother’s love for baking and a daughter’s dream of sharing it with the world.

Together, we blend familiar flavours with fresh ideas, creating cakes and sweet treats that feel both comforting and special.

As a mother-daughter business, we put love and care into everything we make. Our hope is simple: to bring a little sweetness to your celebrations and create moments worth sharing.
